description: Dark membrane on thin bone struts, folded shut. Leathery, and off nothing anyone has cornered yet.
lore: Membrane is the best patch material in the country: waterproof already, takes a stitch without splitting, will not go stiff in cold the way tanned hide does. Boat seams, tent corners, lantern shades. Mostly it goes on bellows, which fail at the fold, always the fold, and a fold lined with wing runs a season past the leather around it — [[characters/646b922c|Sigrun]]'s has three on it, dark on grey, and she dates her own work by which patch is which. Thirteen gold. The man who sells them will tell you he takes them down himself at dusk, with a long pole. He does not. They are found on the ground, folded shut, one at a time, and he has never seen one in the air either.
gm_notes: The commonest wing, and the one with a real industry behind it. Nothing in the setting has yet been seen flying: keep every wing record consistent with that.
